text:
marco: Postmortem follow-up: we need to close the loop on rollout safety improvements. Focus areas: automated rollback hysteresis, hard caps at infra-level, audit + approval flow, and chaos-style sim tests.
jen: +1. I can take the approval flow and console UX for override reasons. We should require 2 approvers for overrides > hard_cap.
oliver: I'll own the infra hard caps and throttling. Plan: enforce at the ingress proxy and have the proxy emit audit events with rollout.id and request.sampled=true.
maya: I'll own the sim/chaos matrix. Proposal: expand beyond single-flag sims to combined-failure modes (DB tail, region latency, model N+1 failures). Output must be CSV with time-series for p50/p95/p99/error-rate.
sre-bot: system: Task TASK-5009 created: implement ingress hard cap and audit events assigned to oliver.
marco: Note on auto-rollback: we want hysteresis so flapping doesn't keep tripping. Proposed rule: require condition for 2 consecutive windows (60s each) and exponential backoff on re-open attempts (1m, 5m, 15m).
jen: For the approval flow: console will show hard_cap, current_sample, quarantine_timer, override button. Override must capture approver, reason, and must be logged to audit service. No UI bypass allowed.
oliver: Implementation sketch for proxy config: 
```
rollout_limits:
  max_percent: 2
  hard_enforce: true
  audit_header: X-Flag-Rollout-Audit
```
sre-bot: system: reminder: staging dry-run scheduled 04/15 09:00 UTC.
maya: sim plan excerpt: sweep sample_rate [0.1%, 0.5%, 1%, 2%], error_inject [0,0.5%,1.5%], latency_add [+20ms,+150ms,+500ms], region_combo [single, paired fail]. Each run creates a summary with triggered_rules list.
marco: Add a regression detector: when a rollout is rolled back, automatically run a small eval set (smoke prompts) and snapshot model outputs to S3 for triage. We need metadata: rollout.id, model.version, sample_rate.
jen: UX question: shall we allow temporary soft caps (product experiments) that expire automatically? I think yes, but require product owner annotation and expiry timestamp.
oliver: We'll support soft_caps in the routing layer but enforce that soft_caps < infra_hard_cap always. If soft_caps expired, traffic snaps back to 0 for that flag.
maya: For CI, I'll add a deterministic seeding mechanism so chaos sims are reproducible across runs. Also hooking sim results to the postmortem ticket automatically.
marco: Owners & deadlines: oliver (ingress caps + audit) PR by Mon 04/13; maya (sim harness + CI) PR by Wed 04/15; jen (console override + approval flow) PR by Fri 04/17.
jen: I'll add docs for audit queries (how to filter by rollout.id and approver) in the runbook.
sre-bot: system: oncall rota updated. Please remember to link PRs here when opened.
marco: One more thing: let's add a nightly job that scans recent rollouts for patterns (multiple small rollouts that together cause spike) and surface candidates for grouping. Could help catch correlated rollouts.
maya: Good idea. I'll add a matrix aggregation to sim outputs to show combined impact.
oliver: OK starting branch "ingress/hard-cap-audit" now. pinging when I have a draft.
marco: Thanks team. We'll review progress in next eng-platform sync. :white_check_mark:
